impacts.text: The issue causes a permanent denial of service for critical functions of the `GTELaunchpadV2Pair` contract:

ambiguities: Omitted stated outcomes: `sync()` - Synchronizing reserves becomes impossible; all launch/base tokens and quote tokens locked in the affected pairs become permanently frozen, resulting in a complete loss of funds for the token launchers (projects partnering with GTE) and other liquidity providers; the issue affects all pairs created for all launch tokens, making it a systemic vulnerability across the entire protocol.
